subject.title: fix: stop doctor misreporting trusted-proxy gateways as unauthenticated

question: Should Doctor treat a complete, runtime-startable trusted-proxy deployment as authenticated for the exposed-bind diagnostic while still emitting explicit proxy/firewall warnings?
rationale: This is a deliberate security-diagnostic policy boundary: the patch does not change runtime authentication, but it changes the severity and remediation operators receive for exposed Gateway configurations.

options.title: Accept runtime-aligned warning
options.body: Approve the narrower classification once current-head evidence confirms all startup-invalid and unsafe proxy configurations remain critical.

options.title: Retain generic critical
options.body: Keep all non-loopback trusted-proxy deployments on the unauthenticated critical path until a separate security-policy design establishes a different operator contract.

recommendation.title: Accept runtime-aligned warning
recommendation.body: Approve the narrower classification once current-head evidence confirms all startup-invalid and unsafe proxy configurations remain critical.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only evidence-backed contact in the supplied history for the proposed runtime-aligned diagnostic behavior; a current-main area owner should co-decide the security policy.
